_note: Rules for this repo's Code Tower, read by the tower, tower/select_rows.py and (from main's copy) the guard and the PR guard. Fields follow chat 06's spec V0.2 §10 vocabulary (values by source, AI-ready test, caps, ladder rung, policy version = main's commit). JSON, not YAML, so the scripts need no extra library. The tower and its workers can never change this file; a change comes as a PR made outside the tower that passes only after Adam adds the 'rules-approved' label and merges it.
_row_branch_note: If cloud sessions refuse pushes to tower/* (the proxy may allow only claude/* branches), change this to claude/tower- in a rules PR; the guard, CI and the PR guard accept both.
_rung_note: 0 = observe: rows are proposed, no worker runs. 1 = draft: workers open draft PRs; a person approves every merge. 2 = not allowed until Adam rules on evidence (plan §7.3).
